verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it reviews the full codebase rather than just the diff (qodo-docs-22), catches breaking changes that diff-only tools miss (qodo-docs-60), and maps how repositories, services and teams connect to show system-wide impact (qodo-docs-14, qodo-docs-34). Blast-radius risk classification (qodo-docs-25) adds impact context for each PR. However, nothing explicitly shows a single review that treats a change split across several repositories as one coherent unit, or any monorepo-specific scaling. Missing for 10: explicit cross-repository review of linked or multi-repo changes, documented monorepo-scale handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-repo understanding.
